sph_interpretive_translation: A man committed to truth and discipline shall demonstrate his boundary-mark clearly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Satya (Truth)
Causation is rooted in conscious intentionality
Capacity-based responsibility requires visible demonstration of dharma
Restoration logic operates through clarity of personal boundaries
Consciousness alignment necessitates external manifestation of internal vrata
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent declares satyavrata THEN agent MUST publicly establish sīmānta
IF no visible sīmānta THEN vrata declaration is NULL in legal cognition
IF boundary not demonstrated THEN capacity for truthful judgment is unestablished
WHEN sīmānta is shown THEN legal standing is automatically recognized
WHEN vrata aligns with visible conduct THEN jurisprudential integrity is self-evident
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any declaration of moral or dharmic commitment must be accompanied by a clear and demonstrable boundary-marker; without such visibility, the court shall treat the claim as legally non-existent. The threshold of responsibility lies not in assertion but in perceptible alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is fulfilled when internal vow manifests externally as sīmānta. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that vrata without demonstration remains causally inert. Proportional responsibility arises from clarity of declared limits. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that misalignment corrects itself upon proper manifestation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Individual must physically demarcate and declare their sīmānta
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reaffirmation of satyavrata before competent witness
Capacity Restoration: Guided practice to align inner discipline with outer conduct
Integrity Reintegration: Public acknowledgment of previous omission followed by corrected demonstration
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Truth-vow demands visible boundary. Dharma is restored when inner discipline meets outer clarity. Reality responds only to manifested alignment. Consciousness alone adjudicates authenticity.
